Bring the power of [Google Earth Engine](https://earthengine.google.com/) into VS Code. Authenticate against an Earth Engine-enabled Google Cloud project, browse and manage assets, follow import and export operations, search the API reference, explore the dataset catalog, and visualise layers on an interactive map without leaving the editor.

## What the extension provides

- **Profiles** for Google OAuth and service-account authentication.
- **Assets** with lazy tree browsing, CRUD actions, full previews, and a paginated manager.
- **Tasks** for import and export monitoring, filtering, cancellation, and auto-refresh.
- **Dataset Catalog** access across Google, Publishers, and Community datasets.
- **API Docs** as a searchable Earth Engine JavaScript reference.
- **Interactive Map** with Earth Engine layers, inspection, visualisation controls, and a Python bridge.

## Requirements

- VS Code 1.125 or later.
- A [Google Earth Engine account](https://signup.earthengine.google.com/).
- A Google Cloud project with the Earth Engine API enabled.
- Python only when using the map bridge from scripts.

Continue with [Getting started](./getting-started).
